prompt:
Design a COMPLETELY NEW compact operator console for the StarNet game, in the world of these references. Image1 is the approved station workstation: camera angle and rendering style. Image2 is the approved plain cargo crate: material finish and readable detail scale. Image3 is the approved bridge: world atmosphere. These are style/scale references, not shapes to copy. Invent the entire new console, including its silhouette, operating surface, hardware layout and luminous display graphics. Do not trace an old sprite or retain any coarse pixel-art components.

NEW DESIGN: a compact low wedge-shaped instrument podium with ONE broad sloped cyan navigation glass surface occupying most of its upper deck. The glass is flush into an angular continuous housing, with clipped rear corners and a narrow central operator recess at the near edge. NO separate upright monitor. On the near rim, one recessed short keyboard strip; on the right shoulder a substantial trackball with three small tactile controls; on the left shoulder two subdued amber status lamps and a capped switch. Two short load-bearing steel legs support the unit with real open knee clearance. Rear rail has a few cooling slots. Carefully designed, distinct functional shapes, not a box covered in unrelated gadgets. Give the glass newly designed fine cyan radar rings, plotted arcs and several restrained instrument traces. Screens and controls must be fully finished new artwork, never pixelated placeholders.

Fixed orthographic overhead-oblique view directly from south, matching workstation reference: parallel horizontal edges, front face below the horizontal/sloped top plane, no lateral yaw, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. At actual game scale the whole object is approximately28 world pixels wide and23 high, roughly three-quarters of the approved workstation's width and the same working height. Preserve this overall silhouette ratio28:23, but invent all internal proportions and shapes intelligently for an adult-sized operator. Tight framing, complete object, no cropped edges.

Near-black and cool charcoal worn steel, broad planes, subtle edge wear and restrained bevel highlights like the crate. Cyan only in display glass, modest amber utility accents. Readable hierarchy at tiny station scale; refined raster game art, not busy miniature filigree, not thick shiny gold armor, not a luxury product render. One isolated complete prop, genuinely transparent RGBA background including knee gap. No room, floor, cast shadow, labels, text or checkerboard.
